meta.purpose: Authoritative, machine-parseable task inventory for the full simulation/feature-coverage loop. Drive four engines (CanDo FEM, mrDNA, oxDNA, NAMD) to cover the four unconventional design features (extra crossover bases, linkers/overhang connections, E-fields, anchors) AND emit a shared, comparable set of prediction descriptors so engines cross-validate each other.
meta.reference_policy: per-observable: oxDNA is reference for relaxed shape + field-deflection; CanDo is reference for RMSF/flexibility; NAMD becomes gold for any observable once a NAMD run for that design exists (overrides).
meta.loop_invariant: The loop edits ONLY task.status and task.notes (and milestone.status, derived). It MUST NOT add, remove, reorder, or rewrite tasks, deps, oracles, or any other field. Scope changes, new tasks, or re-prioritization require the user. Seeded all-pending on purpose (nothing is 'done' until its oracle passes).
meta.three_layer_law: Every engine output here is PHYSICAL/display-only. Anchors + field specs are JOB-REQUEST annotations, never Design edits. CanDo extra-base/linker ELEMENTS are mesh-build details derived from existing topology metadata (Crossover.extra_bases, overhang_connections), not topology mutations.

tasks.title: shape_metrics.py — engine-agnostic shape descriptors (global twist, bend angle + radius, Rg, end-to-end) from a display-position map
tasks.oracle: synthetic straight -> twist~0; known-bend fixture -> arc-span within tol; generalize exp36 6-fold-twist + arc-span estimators; can-go-red on a scrambled frame
tasks.notes: backend/core/shape_metrics.py compute_shape_descriptors(positions) composes the locked oxdna_health estimators into one engine-agnostic set: twist_total_deg, twist_per_turn_deg (axial_span/BDNA_PITCH), bend_angle_deg + bend_radius_nm (both from one bundle_slab_centreline via _chord_sagitta_bend), radius_of_gyration_nm, end_to_end_nm (axial-end cross-section centroids), axial_span_nm, n_nucleotides. Degenerate frames -> per-descriptor None (twist needs >=2 helices). Added ONE purely-additive helper bundle_slab_centreline to oxdna_health (+31/-0, locked estimators untouched). 9/9 oracle tests (tests/test_shape_metrics.py) fast. Caller must core-filter real frames. No UI (card is S5).

tasks.title: Unified RMSF profile + deviation profile (generalize cando_deviation.compute_deviation + fem_solver normalize_rmsf) into shape_metrics
tasks.oracle: identical predicted==intended -> deviation RMSD 0; synthetic displaced frame -> known per-nt deviation; RMSF profile round-trips
tasks.notes: shape_metrics.py gained 3 engine-agnostic primitives (read-only over positions, no topology): deviation_profile(cand, ref, align=True) — per-nt deviation + rmsd_nm; align=True Kabsch (generalizes oxdna_health.geometry_deviation_map/measure_geometry_rmsd via _kabsch_superpose, strips rigid pose, shape survives), align=False direct key-match (generalizes cando_deviation.compute_deviation, exact residual). rmsf_from_ensemble(frames, align=True) — per-nt RMS fluctuation about the mean over a frame list (generalizes production_rmsf's variance core minus oxDNA file I/O; the trajectory-variance RMSF source for oxDNA/NAMD/mrDNA; CanDo supplies NMA rmsf directly). normalize_rmsf_profile — generalizes fem_solver.normalize_rmsf to a keyed [0,1] map from any {helix_id,bp_index,direction?,rmsf_nm} list (dir-less -> both strands). Copy-aware keys throughout. 10/10 fast oracle (tests/test_shape_deviation_rmsf.py): identical->rmsd 0, known non-rigid displacement recovered exactly (align=False), rigid pose removed by Kabsch, shear survives, A/sqrt(2) fluctuation round-trip, align=True strips bulk drift keeps site fluctuation, normalize max->1 + rescale-back + all-zero safe. No UI (card is S5). Ready for S3 compare_descriptors.

tasks.title: compare_descriptors(cand, ref) — per-observable reference selection + agreement math (scalar %delta, RMSF Pearson/Spearman, aligned-shape RMSD via _rigid_superpose)
tasks.oracle: identical inputs -> perfect agreement; known-perturbed input -> expected deltas/correlation; reference-selection honors per-observable policy incl. NAMD-override-when-present
tasks.notes: shape_metrics.py gained the cross-engine agreement layer (pure over Physical-layer dicts, no topology). compare_descriptors(candidate, reference, *, align_shape=True) scores agreement on the three comparable observable classes S1/S2 emit: (1) COMPARABLE_SCALARS (7 shape descriptors) -> {candidate, reference, abs_delta, signed_pct_delta} where pct = (cand-ref)/|ref|*100, None scalars incomparable, zero-ref -> abs_delta w/ None pct (no div0); (2) rmsf -> Pearson+Spearman over shared base pairs, {pearson, spearman, n, candidate/reference_mean_rmsf_nm}, degenerate (constant/<2 shared) -> None coeff not NaN; (3) shape_rmsd_nm via deviation_profile(align=True) Kabsch (rigid pose zeroed, real shape survives). reference_for(engines, observable) applies per-observable policy (shape/field->oxdna, rmsf->cando) with NAMD gold-override across all observables, missing engine/unknown observable -> None. KEY FIX (review-caught, HIGH): _rmsf_per_bp collapses BOTH profiles to per-(helix,bp,copy) mean over strand direction -- CanDo NMA RMSF is direction-less (1/bp) while ensemble RMSF is per-strand (2/bp); direction keying left the designated CanDo-vs-oxDNA pairing with an empty intersection (silent None). 13/13 fast oracle tests/test_shape_compare.py incl. the mixed-direction cross-engine case. No UI (card = S5). M-METRIC-CORE now S3 done; S4 (field-response, deps S1) + S5 (card, deps S3) remain.
